title: Perplexity open-sources Numbat to monitor and block risky agent actions
friendlyTitle: Numbat watches AI agents for risky actions on computers
summary: Perplexity has released Numbat, an Apache-licensed endpoint security suite for detecting, investigating and optionally blocking risky AI-agent behaviour on macOS, Linux and Windows. It integrates with common client-side agent harnesses and keeps detection local while producing forensic records.
friendlySummary: Perplexity released a free security tool that can record, detect and sometimes stop dangerous agent activity on Windows, Mac and Linux computers.
whyItMatters: An agent can cause harm while pursuing an ordinary goal, even without a malicious prompt. Endpoint-level policy and audit records give security teams another control layer when coding or desktop agents have access to files, credentials and business systems.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Companies can see more clearly what agents do and block some unsafe actions before damage happens. The records may contain sensitive details and need protection too.
